scripts.build:packages: bun run build:wasm && bun run --filter '@sheetwrite/core' build && bun run --filter '@sheetwrite/react' build && bun run --filter '@sheetwrite/vue' build
scripts.typecheck:packages: bun run --filter '@sheetwrite/core' typecheck && bun run --filter '@sheetwrite/wasm' typecheck && bun run --filter '@sheetwrite/react' typecheck && bun run --filter '@sheetwrite/vue' typecheck && bun run --filter '@sheetwrite/svelte' typecheck
scripts.typecheck: bun run typecheck:packages && bun run typecheck:examples && bun run typecheck:verification && bun run typecheck:bench
scripts.verify:packages: bun run build && bun run typecheck:packages && bun run verify:packed
scripts.verify:examples: bun run build:examples && bun run typecheck:examples
scripts.examples: bun run build:packages && bun run --filter '@sheetwrite/example-site' dev
